Sunscreen

Moisturizers

turns.reply:
Infinity is running more than a one-product offer: its current pages show several sun-care deals, plus a separate multi-buy offer for the Naturals collection. But the exact deal terms aren’t consistent across the pages I could read, so I wouldn’t treat every sunscreen as part of one clean, store-wide campaign.

- The homepage currently says “Buy 2, Get 3 Free” on Infinity Naturals; add five items, pay for two, with promo packs and bundles excluded. [Homepage](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/)
- Its sun-care collection lists multiple discounted sunscreens and promo packs. One cream page displays EGP 340 and EGP 204 alongside “40% OFF,” which conflicts internally; the mist promo-pack page shows EGP 624 and EGP 312 with “50% OFF.” [Sun care](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/collections/sun-care) · [Cream](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-naturals-sunscreen-cream-spf-50-all-skin-types) · [Mist promo pack](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-care-sunscreen-mist-spf50-promopack)
- The ultra-fluid SPF50+ page shows different prices across reads: EGP 700 on the page I opened, EGP 900 in a result for a variant URL. I can’t resolve which applies to the selected version. [Ultra Fluid](https://infinityclinicpharma.com/products/infinity-care-sunscreen-ultra-fluid-spf50-1-1)

What might explain it: the multi-buy rules and Infinity’s terms limiting customers to one order during “Big Deals and offers” suggest a planned sales promotion, potentially encouraging larger baskets. That’s a plausible read of the mechanics—not a stated reason. I found no official explanation for why the offers are running, and the daily moisturizer page didn’t expose readable product details.

The saved readings show no recorded structured price or stock changes for the watched Infinity products from Oct 1–10, Cairo time. Those readings don’t include campaign terms, so they can’t date when these offers began. The product pages support “offers are present now,” not “a new campaign just started.”

Post clear sunscreen details and invite questions about choosing SPF50. Count useful sunscreen enquiries this week; that directly matches your goal without spending time or margin on an unsupported discount.
